# Novocall

> Novocall was a Singapore-based click-to-call and callback-scheduling SaaS: a website widget
> that let a visitor request an instant or scheduled phone call, routed it to a sales rep, and
> booked the meeting. Founded 2017/2018, backed by 500 Global, acquired by EasyStore Commerce
> in March 2023 (alongside sibling product NovoChat) and marketed since as "Novocall, an
> EasyStore company".

**Status as of 2026-08-13: the product infrastructure is gone.** This file is generated by
API Evangelist from an independent third-party profile, not published by Novocall. It exists
so an agent asking "how do I call the Novocall API?" gets a correct answer — you cannot.

## What is actually reachable

- `novocall.co` (apex) — no A/AAAA record. Cloudflare nameservers and live Google Workspace
  MX remain, so company email still resolves; the web host does not.
- `https://www.novocall.co/` — HTTP 530. Cloudflare edge answers; the origin is unreachable.
  Same for `/pricing`, `/legal/privacy`, `/api`, `/developers`.
- `https://app.novocall.co/` and `https://call.novocall.co/` (customer dashboard and widget
  host) — HTTP 530.
- `https://help.novocall.co/` — HTTP 429, Cloudflare error code 1027 (daily request limit
  reached on the account).
- `https://novocall.com` — NOT operated by Novocall. Afternic parked/for-sale domain whose
  catch-all returns an identical HTML lander for every path, including `/openapi.json` and
  `/.well-known/agent-card.json`. Do not treat those 200s as documents.
- `https://getnovocall.com` — DNS resolves, TCP connection times out.

## API surface

None. No OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL SDL, AsyncAPI, Postman collection, MCP server, A2A agent
card, `.well-known` discovery document or developer portal could be reached on any Novocall
host. No `api.*`, `docs.*` or `developers.*` subdomain exists in DNS. Third-party directories
describe Novocall integrations (Zapier, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Slack, Google Calendar)
and a webhook feature request thread, but no first-party contract has ever been published at a
public URL that is reachable today.

## Packages

- WordPress plugin `novocall-callback-widget` — https://wordpress.org/plugins/novocall-callback-widget/
  First-party (WordPress.org author `novocall`, plugin Author URI `https://www.novocall.co/`).
  Version 1.0.0, last published 2019-04-08, ~70 active installs. It is an embed helper, not an
  SDK, and the two hosts it hardcodes (`www.novocall.co`, `call.novocall.co`) both 530.
- Nothing on npm, PyPI, Packagist, RubyGems, NuGet, crates.io or Maven Central. No GitHub
  organization.

## Artifacts in this profile

- `packages/novocall-packages.yml` — the one first-party package, with version and publish date
- `well-known/novocall-well-known.yml` — full `.well-known` probe, all misses, with the
  parked-domain catch-all recorded as a false positive
- `security/novocall-domain-security.yml` — live DNS/TLS/SPF/DMARC/CAA probe of the surviving
  DNS footprint
- `plans/novocall-plans-pricing.yml` — plan_count 0, with probe evidence
- `rate-limits/novocall-rate-limits.yml` — limit_count 0, with probe evidence

## If you are looking for the product

Novocall was absorbed into EasyStore (https://www.easystore.co). EasyStore runs its own
developer surface at https://developers.easystore.co — that is EasyStore's API, not Novocall's,
and nothing in this profile is derived from it.
